estimator: Candidate-stratum Hájek ratio using inverse inclusion weights, multiplied by known stratum candidate count; add known structural negatives and divide by full arm size.
caveat: Sparse stratified audit; point estimates only. Missing-vote bounds exclude sampling and evaluator error. The audit DeepSeek column separates audit-sampling variation from evaluator variation.

correction.scope: Consistency sensitivity within the original frozen sampling frame. Newly identified calls outside that frame are covered by primary rejudging, not by these three-evaluator estimates.
